combatants.notes: Dread Ambusher rd 1: +10 spd, bonus attack +1d8

npc_blocks.title: Pheromone Crowner (Spring) — Medium Monstrosity (ant), Lawful Evil
npc_blocks.stats: AC 15 (natural armor) | HP 134 (17d8+51) | Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft. | STR 14 (+2) DEX 14 (+2) CON 16 (+3) INT 10 (+0) WIS 16 (+3) CHA 16 (+3)
npc_blocks.defenses: Skills: Perception +6, Insight +6 | Senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 13 | Languages: Ant-cant (chemical), Common (halting) | CR 5 (1800 XP) | PB +3

entries.name: Heated Body
entries.text: A creature that touches the Crowner or hits her with a melee attack while within 5 ft. takes 2d6 fire damage. Sheds bright light 5 ft. and dim light another 5 ft.

entries.name: Pheromone Sense
entries.text: Aware of the location and emotional state of every fire ant within 120 ft. Senses emotional states of non-ants within 60 ft. (adv on Insight vs them).

entries.name: Visible Scent-Trails
entries.text: Pheromone commands glow faintly in the air for 1 round after release. Narrative only except as specified in Scorch-Trail.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Crowner makes two Bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+2) piercing plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Scorch-Trail (Recharge 5–6)
entries.text: Draws a 30-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, from her. Each creature in or entering the line before her next turn: DC 13 CON save, 7 (2d6) fire on fail, half on success. On fail, also marked — next attack against it before the end of the Crowner's next turn has advantage. Allied ants moving along the line: +10 ft. speed for that movement, +1d6 fire on next melee hit before end of turn.

entries.name: Crown-Scent (1/turn)
entries.text: One ally she can see within 30 ft. gains advantage on its next attack roll before end of its next turn, OR may immediately move up to half its speed without provoking OAs.

npc_blocks.title: Skull-Cracker (Spring) — Large Monstrosity (ant), Lawful Evil
npc_blocks.stats: AC 16 (natural armor) | HP 162 (16d10+64) | Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft. | STR 20 (+5) DEX 10 (+0) CON 18 (+4) INT 6 (-2) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 10 (+0)
npc_blocks.defenses: Skills: Athletics +8 | Senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 11 | Languages: Ant-cant (chemical, simple) | CR 6 (2300 XP) | PB +3

entries.name: Heated Body
entries.text: A creature that touches the Skull-Cracker or hits him with a melee attack while within 5 ft. takes 2d6 fire damage. Mandibles glow forge-hot; dim light to 10 ft.

entries.name: Head-Heavy
entries.text: Disadvantage on DEX saves vs prone. Advantage on STR saves/checks to resist being moved, grappled, or shoved.

entries.name: Forge-Mandibles
entries.text: Bite ignores resistance to piercing damage. Non-magical armor broken by Crusher's Bite is charred — requires a proper forge to restore.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Two Crusher's Bite attacks, or one Crusher's Bite + one Mandible Slam. May replace one Crusher's Bite with Sear-Snap if available.

entries.name: Crusher's Bite
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire. On hit vs non-magical armor, armor cracks: AC -1 until repaired (stacks to -3 per creature).

entries.name: Mandible Slam
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning. Target DC 15 STR save or grappled (escape DC 15). Only one target grappled this way at a time.

entries.name: Sear-Snap (Recharge 5–6)
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8+3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire. If target is prone or grappled, fire damage doubles (to 14 / 4d6) and wound smolders: target takes 3 (1d6) fire at start of each of its turns until it succeeds on a DC 13 CON save at the end of its turn.

npc_blocks.title: Leafcutter Worker — Medium Monstrosity (ant), Neutral
npc_blocks.stats: AC 13 (natural armor) | HP 58 (9d8+18) | Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft. | STR 14 (+2) DEX 12 (+1) CON 14 (+2) INT 6 (-2) WIS 10 (+0) CHA 8 (-1)
npc_blocks.defenses: Senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 10 | Languages: Ant-cant (chemical) | CR 1/2 (100 XP) | PB +2

entries.name: Beast of Burden
entries.text: Carrying capacity as if one size larger. Can drag/haul up to 5x normal capacity without penalty.

entries.name: Leaf-Slicer Mandibles
entries.text: Outside combat, mandibles cleanly cut leaves, cloth, paper, thin wood. Can strip a leaf in seconds.

entries.name: Reluctant Soldier
entries.text: When every fire ant commander/overseer in the encounter is dead or fled, at the start of its next turn the worker makes a DC 10 WIS save. On fail: stands down (flees, surrenders, or parlays). On success: fights on with disadvantage on attack rolls until a new commander arrives or combat ends.

entries.name: Mandible Snip
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) slashing damage.

pc_blocks.header: Jiminy 'Drix' Hendrix (Katie) — Bard 3 (College of Lore) | Cricket | AC 15 | HP 21 | Speed 30 | Passive Perception 12 | Init +3
pc_blocks.saves: DEX +5 (prof), CHA +6 (prof). Others use ability mod.
pc_blocks.attacks: Rapier +5, 1d8+3 piercing  |  Shortsword +5, 1d6+3 piercing  |  Spell attack +6, Spell save DC 14.
pc_blocks.spells: Cantrips: Vicious Mockery, Prestidigitation. 1st (4 slots): Healing Word, Disguise Self, Silvery Barbs, Dissonant Whispers. 2nd (2 slots): Hold Person, Locate Animals or Plants.
pc_blocks.features: Bardic Inspiration (d6, 4 uses, bonus action, 60 ft.). Jack of All Trades (+1 to non-prof checks). Cutting Words (reaction: spend Inspiration die to subtract from enemy attack/check/damage). Song Distraction (homebrew: Performance vs Insight, grabs attention; target has disadv on Perception/Investigation while you perform).

pc_blocks.header: Nancy Alfons (ROWYN) — Rogue 3 (Arcane Trickster) | Jumping Spider | AC 15 | HP 22 | Speed 40 | Passive Perception 11 | Init +3
pc_blocks.saves: DEX +5 (prof), INT +5 (prof). Others use ability mod.
pc_blocks.attacks: Rapier +5, 1d8 piercing  |  Shortbow +5, 1d6 piercing (80/320)  |  Spell attack +5, Spell save DC 13.  |  Sneak Attack 2d6 once per turn (conditions apply).
pc_blocks.spells: Cantrips: Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion. 1st (2 slots): Disguise Self, Detect Magic (ritual), Identify (ritual).
pc_blocks.features: Mobile (feat): +10 speed; Dash ignores difficult terrain; melee target can't OA you rest of turn. Fey Touched (feat). Cunning Action (bonus: Dash/Disengage/Hide). Expertise: Sleight of Hand +7, Investigation +7.

pc_blocks.header: Tabatha Starr (Heather) — Ranger 3 (Gloomstalker) | Lone Star Tick | AC 14 | HP 31 | Speed 30 | Passive Perception 14 | Init +5 (WIS via Dread Ambusher)
pc_blocks.saves: STR +4 (prof), DEX +5 (prof). Others use ability mod.
pc_blocks.attacks: Longbow +7, 1d8+3 piercing (150/600) [Archery]  |  Dagger (thrown) +7, 1d4+3 piercing (20/60) [Archery per DM ruling]  |  Dagger (melee) +5, 1d4+3 piercing.  |  1st-level slots: 3.
pc_blocks.spells: Spell list not yet provided by player. Ranger 3 has spells — ask Heather at the table.
pc_blocks.features: Favored Enemy: Monstrosities (adv on WIS to track, INT to recall). Favored Terrain: Forest. Archery Fighting Style (+2 to ranged attack rolls). Dread Ambusher: +10 speed round 1; bonus attack on turn 1, +1d8 on hit; WIS added to init. Umbral Sight: darkvision 60 ft.; invisible to darkvision creatures in darkness. Sharpshooter (homebrew feat): ignore long-range disadv, ignore half/three-quarters cover, -5 to hit for +10 damage.

notes.label: Setup
notes.text: Whole party present: Drix (Bard), Nancy (Rogue), Tabby (Ranger). Traveling toward the Winter Farm with the Leafcutter Rebel and Leafcutter Loyalist in tow (see NPC Registry). Loyalist is planning to betray the party at earliest opportunity — GM's call whether this encounter is that betrayal payoff. Terrain not specified.

notes.label: Difficulty note
notes.text: Combined CR 13 (Crowner 5 + Skull-Cracker 6 + 4x Worker 0.5 = CR 13) against three level-3 PCs. This is a Deadly-tier encounter. Consider positioning, cover, retreat paths.

notes.label: Reluctant Soldier trigger
notes.text: If BOTH the Pheromone Crowner and the Skull-Cracker are killed or flee, each surviving Leafcutter Worker makes a DC 10 WIS save at the start of its next turn. Fail: stands down (flees, surrenders, parlays). Success: fights on with DISADVANTAGE on attack rolls. This is the party's lever — kill the commanders, fold the workers.

notes.label: Recharge tracking
notes.text: Crowner: Scorch-Trail (5–6). Skull-Cracker: Sear-Snap (5–6). Roll at start of each of their turns.

notes.label: Crowner tactics
notes.text: Opens with Scorch-Trail to carve the field and set up allies. Uses Crown-Scent every round. Positions so Heated Body aura catches flankers. Retreats below half HP (67) to rally a second wave.

notes.label: Skull-Cracker tactics
notes.text: Opens with Mandible Slam on nearest heavy-armor target (Tabby is best candidate). Bites grappled targets. Holds Sear-Snap for the turn after a successful grapple — grappled target takes doubled fire + smolder effect. Drops grapple only for a more dangerous target.

notes.label: Leafcutter tactics
notes.text: Shared initiative (7). Fight where directed — point them at whoever the Crowner marks. Without commander direction, hesitate and target the most obvious threat (not the most dangerous). Do NOT pursue fleeing foes.

notes.label: NPC Registry cross-ref
notes.text: Leafcutter Rebel (disposition: Allied) and Leafcutter Loyalist (disposition: Hostile, covert) are with the party. The Rebel may aid the party; the Loyalist will seize the chance to bolt or betray.
